Hi all! It was so hard to find a picture of myself that served good for this introduction. 

I am Anurag, a video production specialist by profession and a wanderer by heart. I am from India. I am joining this group because I am planning to move to Israel with my partner who is making Aaliyah in September and I am looking forward to connecting with people on this group. 

I thank the admins for approving my request. 

Also just wanted to inform that I am looking for immigration lawyers who can help us with the process and also a career counsellor who can help me with a consultation. I have a lot of doubts as to how I am going to find work once I am there. 

Thank you so much!
